title: Tested _self eval rows for the --do split rule and the token-count identifier and phase-token exceptions
goal: The _self root's lookup_eval.csv holds a row whose phrase quotes the split rule ST-piqs2azs documented for --do (the = after the longest --option value) plus a row for each exception BG-xp3imb24 documented (the TOKENS constant, the phase token), landed through the code lane, since ST-b56r6a7v's --do row expects only that --do gives an option its do field and its token row only the model-token-count exception (found at the SP-uzwbt63u review)

run: import csv, sys; rows = list(csv.reader(open('kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv', encoding='utf-8'))); q = ' '.join(' '.join(r) for r in rows).lower(); sys.exit(0 if 'longest' in q and 'phase token' in q and '_tokens' in q else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 1 of 15, "Lookup terms and benchmark statistics: build numbers, bare versions, inert aliases and nearest-rank p95"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: no row of kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv holds 'longest', 'phase token' and '_tokens' together, so the split rule and the TOKENS-constant and phase-token exceptions have no tested question; run at plan 2026-10-13: the item's check exits 1 on base (reproduces).
